LESSON 34 / ADDITIONAL INTERVIEW CONCEPT
File inputs and multipart form encoding

A file upload form typically uses POST and multipart/form-data so files and text fields are sent as
separate parts. accept is a client-side file chooser hint.
File upload එකෙකේ සඳහා POST සහ multipart/form-data භාවි+ කෙරනවා. accept එJකෙන් file chooser එකෙට file type hint එකෙකේ Jදෙයි; server එJකෙන් file type සහ size validate කෙරන්න ඕJන්.
A student uploads a CV file.
Upload CV · Student · Multipart body · Kamal · Part: student · Choose file: cv.pdf · Part: CV bytes · Upload

Read the diagram: The browser sends the text and file as separate parts. The server should verify
type, size, storage policy and authorization. accept is not a security check.

<form action="/upload" method="post"
      enctype="multipart/form-data">
  <label>CV <input type="file" name="cv"
         accept="application/pdf" required></label>
  <button>Upload</button>
</form>
Expected result: The browser sends the chosen file in a multipart request to the upload endpoint.
Answer: It encodes file contents and other fields as distinct parts of a request.
Practice: Build a file upload form and inspect its request.
